label: Origin-deletion controls on three finite interpretations
paraphrase: Closed mathematical controls, every individual counted concrete. (1) In the five-world encoded origin-tolerance countermodel (OriginToleranceIdentity.Control.faithful): individual deletion holds at actual, fails at plus (b exists at plus and at every world plus accesses), and so fails at some world accessible from actual. (2) In the three-offset model with one individual existing at every offset (OriginToleranceIdentity.Control.restored), deletion fails at the actual offset. (3) The faithful model with a sixth world at which no individual exists, accessible from and to every world, origins and the rest of access unchanged: closeness is a tolerance, access is determined by origin closeness, every near origin variation is realised, an individual has non-near origins at two successors of actual, origin-compatible deletion holds and deletion holds at every world. Statements about these finite interpretations only.
